incidents.name: tCDP transferFrom checks the wrong allowance
incidents.notes: tCDP.transferFrom() debits _allowed[msg.sender][to] instead of checking _allowed[from][msg.sender], so a self-approval let the attacker move every outstanding tCDP balance out of three unrelated holders and burn it to redeem the contract's Compound ETH collateral.

sources.ref: onchain review: tCDP 0xdA4c9Ee8373fd1095379a3Dd457A0c78968AaF03 created 2020-05-23T14:50:40Z by 0x1d075f1f543bb09df4530f44ed21ca50303a65b2 (one of the drained holders), not the attack-tx sender 0xd49cb0924f871bcfd78ea4187d9e6bd943f85d98; no EIP-1967 events, 1800.4 days old. 2.02 ETH x $1,775.02 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $3,586.
